title: When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls
abstract: arXiv:2610.00373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. translated_title: 注意力头消融何时能支持因果断言？投影层面的混杂因素、地板效应与匹配对照
translated_abstract: 注意力头消融——即将某个注意力头置零并测量由此产生的任务性能变化——是推断语言模型中哪些组件对某一行为负有因果责任的常用方法。我们以 GPT-2 small 为例证明，除非对干预语义、评估指标和对照条件进行仔细验证，否则这一推断可能是脆弱的。“置零一个头”的一种自然的投影后实现方式与校正后的投影前消融几乎不相关（Pearson r = 0.057），并且所选出的重要头 top-5 集合完全不同。我们还表明，二值准确率会掩盖处于行为地板和接近天花板时的效应，而标准答案词元的对数概率则保持有梯度。通过使用发现集/保留集划分以及 1,000 次匹配的随机头和同层匹配头对照抽样，校正后的逐头效应排序在不同划分间高度稳定（Spearman rho = 0.974），且所选 top-5 头显著优于……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文证明注意力头消融得出的因果结论只有在仔细验证干预语义、评估指标和匹配对照后才可靠：朴素投影后置零与校正后的投影前消融几乎不相关，二值准确率会掩盖地板和天花板处的效应，而校正后的排序在对照检验下高度稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that causal claims from attention-head ablation are fragile unless intervention semantics, evaluation metrics, and matched controls are carefully validated: naive post-projection zeroing is nearly uncorrelated with corrected pre-projection ablation, binary accuracy masks floor and ceiling effects, and the corrected head-effect ranking is highly stable under 1,000 matched control draws.
